creatures.name: Ash Mite

abilities.name: Scurry
abilities.rule: May Disengage as a bonus action; if it escapes into a crack, it cannot attack from there.

creatures.goal: Feed on a warm lantern and flee.
creatures.noncombat: Distract with lantern oil or leave the light unguarded.

creatures.name: Roadknife Toll-Robber

abilities.name: Cornered
abilities.rule: May Disengage as a bonus action only when at half HP or lower.

creatures.goal: Acquire food and coins, not die for a toll.
creatures.morale: Surrenders or flees at half HP if given a route.
creatures.noncombat: Food, persuasion or showing a Warden token can avoid combat.

creatures.name: Mire Wolf

abilities.name: Dragging Snap
abilities.rule: Once per encounter after a hit, target makes DC12 Strength save or falls Prone.

creatures.goal: Defend its litter near the flood line.
creatures.noncombat: Circle the den or offer food from a safe distance.

creatures.name: Lantern Wisp

abilities.name: Flicker
abilities.rule: Can move through gaps at least one inch wide but cannot cross solid stone; when struck by water takes 2 extra damage.

creatures.goal: Lure the unwary toward exposed bell metal.
creatures.noncombat: Cover the light or use the route's old bell words to calm it.

creatures.name: Bell-Husk

abilities.name: Off-Key Peal
abilities.rule: Once per encounter as action: a creature within 20 ft makes DC12 Wisdom save or is Disoriented until end of its next turn.

creatures.goal: Prevent theft of the chamber's memory-plate.
creatures.morale: Never pursues beyond the chamber threshold.
creatures.noncombat: Can be delayed by striking the chamber handbell in a steady 3-beat rhythm.

creatures.name: Gaunt Toller

abilities.name: Ninth Peal
abilities.rule: Once per encounter as action, unless bell lever jammed: one creature within 30 ft makes DC12 Wisdom save or is Frightened until end of its next turn.

abilities.name: Bound to Threshold
abilities.rule: Cannot willingly cross the old tollhouse entrance; stops attacking a creature that retreats beyond it.

creatures.goal: Keep the failing tollhouse bell ringing until the ward is renewed.
creatures.morale: Offers a bargain after taking 13 or more damage; does not pursue retreat.
creatures.noncombat: Present a valid memory-offering, discover and speak its old toll formula, or disable the striker via environment.
